channel.title: Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly (masslawyersweekly.com)

item.title: Disciplinary orders entered
item.description: Recent disciplinary notices from the Board of Bar Overseers.

item.title: Admonition No. 26-01
item.description: The respondent received an admonition for lack of diligence in a probate matter.

item.title: Order (Public Reprimand) entered by the Board of Bar Overseers on Jan. 20
item.description: By stipulation, the respondent received a public reprimand for failing to make reasonable efforts to ensure his employee’s conduct was compatible with his ethical obligations and failing to maintain adequate IOLTA records.

item.title: Judgment (Disbarment & Acceptance of Affidavit of Resignation) entered by Justice Kafker on Jan. 15
item.description: The respondent resigned and was disbarred following his felony conviction in federal court for engaging in a scheme to bribe a local police chief.

item.title: BBO to hold reinstatement hearing
item.description: The Board of Bar Overseers will hold a public hearing on the petition for reinstatement of Leonard Nicholas Mancuso of Revere, who has been suspended since 2010.

item.title: Plaintiff: baby born dead due to mishandled delivery
item.description: The plaintiff was pregnant when her water broke on Aug. 21, 2023. She immediately went to the hospital where she was admitted to the labor floor for the initiation of labor.

item.title: Welcome to the Granite State
item.description: Boston law firm Libby, Hoopes, Brooks & Mulvey celebrated the opening of its new office in Concord, New Hampshire, with a Jan. 15 reception.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to facilitate deported college student’s return
item.description: A federal judge in Boston on Feb. 13 ordered the Trump administration to facilitate the return of a Honduran college student who was deported in violation of a court order, […]

item.title: Court action pledged as landmark EPA finding is rolled back
item.description: The EPA under the Trump administration rescinded the 2009 Endangerment Finding on greenhouse gases, prompting Massachusetts officials to pledge court action.

item.title: Trump administration sues Harvard, accuses it of defying admissions probe
item.description: The Trump administration sued Harvard University for failing to provide documents on race-conscious admissions, seeking to enforce compliance with a 2023 Supreme Court ruling.
